experiments.name: E14 trade finder
experiments.data_label: REAL HISTORICAL outcomes (nflverse weekly points 2020–2025); SIMULATED league behaviour
experiments.description: E14 trade finder: do the suggested packages help the team making them, and are they fair to the other team? (E6 leagues, 12-team 1QB PPR)

candidates.finder: Finder (app): top option by expected lineup points (minimal, maxEdge 5%)
candidates.finder_any: Finder: any of the options shown (mean over up to 5)
candidates.lineup_value: Finder ranked by starting-lineup value instead of expected points
candidates.most_even: Value only: the most evenly valued fair package (no roster view)
candidates.random_fair: A random fair minimal package (no roster view)
candidates.not_minimal: Finder without the no-throw-in rule (top by expected points)
candidates.edge10: Finder with maxEdge 10% (I may take more value)
candidates.edge0: Finder with maxEdge 0% (I never receive more value)
candidates.edge_close: Finder with the model's "close" band only (UI fairness "Model's close")
candidates.two_max: Finder with packages of at most 2 assets
candidates.mutual_filter: Their roster known: their expected lineup may not fall (≥ 0), top by my gain
candidates.mutual_sum: Their roster known: rank by my + their expected gain (mine must still improve)
candidates.mutual_min: Their roster known: rank by the smaller of the two gains (mine must still improve)
candidates.pen05: Finder with a size penalty (0.5 pts/wk per extra asset)
